svg.title: Clips and cuts: construction sheet
svg.text: The white band has a disc cut out of it, drawn dashed.
The group keeps only what’s inside its clip, a polygon, drawn dashed.
The white rect has a path cut out of it, drawn dashed, and so does each of its copies.
3 white rects in a line, each 5 along the fly from the one before. The first is measured.
The red disc keeps only what’s inside its clip, an ellipse, drawn dashed.
The first 3 of 3 white rects in a line, and
the steps between them. Each is 3 × 2.
Sizes in grid units, as the file gives them. Each charge’s center is marked +.
